title: Introduce onboard-minifier and perf-fingerprint serializer
author: Asha Patel
body: Context: onboarding pipelines have been producing very verbose manifests and long-form changelogs that make automated release triage and quick compatibility heuristics slow. Motivation: provide a compact, deterministic summary of a model's onboarding metadata and a tiny performance fingerprint to speed up compatibility checks, changelog micro-drafts, and UI previews. What this PR does: adds an 'onboard-minifier' server-side transform and CLI that compacts model manifests (schema v2) by removing non-essential stamping and normalizing metadata into a canonical order; introduces a perf-fingerprint serializer that runs a light-weight sampled evaluation (configurable slices) to produce a deterministic 128-bit fingerprint plus a 64-byte base64-encoded performance sketch which is stored alongside the compact manifest; wires a changelog-microdraft hook that synthesizes a one-line delta blurb using the minified diff and the fingerprint delta to help reviewers triage impact quickly. Includes a DB migration to add a compact_stamp column and new indices for quick affinity lookups. Backwards compatibility: manifests produced by the minifier include a compatibility-stamp and a human-readable expansion map to avoid breaking older consumers. Migration tools: small migration script that backfills compact_stamp for last 30 days of ingests using sampled runs (opt-in by default). Checklist: - [x] unit tests for minifier and serializer - [x] integration test for CLI roundtrip - [x] docs page (docs/onboard-minifier.md) with migration instructions - [x] migration script and dry-run mode - [x] reviewer sign-offs. Related work: references ENG-4920 (onboard scale optimizations) and ENG-4978 (changelog automation enhancements). Link to design doc: internal: /docs/design/onboard-minifier (internal link).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can the minifier be configured to retain arbitrary vendor metadata via a whitelist? (requested to avoid losing downstream fields)
Asha Patel: Yes — the CLI and service accept a --keep-fields whitelist and we persist an expansion_map in the compact manifest. Added tests for expansion_map behavior.
Maya Chen: Perf-fingerprint should be stable across parallel runs and not rely on non-deterministic ordering. Please ensure deterministic seeds and explicit sort orders.
Asha Patel: Implemented deterministic sampling seed derived from model-id+manifest-hash and enforced canonical ordering before sampling. Added comment and test in test_fingerprint_serializer.py.
Diego Rivera: DB migration needs a backfill strategy that is rate-limited to avoid overloading the main DB cluster during rollout.
Asha Patel: Migration script implements batching with exponential backoff and a dry-run flag; documentation section describes rollout knobs.
release_notes:
- Add onboard-minifier: compact manifest generation (schema v2) to reduce registry storage and speed UI previews.
- Add perf-fingerprint serializer: deterministic 128-bit fingerprint + compact sketch stored with manifest for fast compatibility heuristics.
- Add changelog micro-draft hook: one-line delta summaries for faster reviewer triage.
Notes: migration is opt-in by default; follow docs/onboard-minifier.md for rollout and backfill procedure.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2024-11-12 after approvals from reviewers and green CI. No release tag created by this PR; follow release automation to include manifest sheen in next release cycle.
